name: Howard County, IA
findings: Howard County has 61 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (15%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Howard County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Howard County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Howard County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
